2026-10-07T05:42:31.0624100Z   pr_body: ## Summary

PRs https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/pull/6288 and https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/pull/6209 (review runs [37395427989](https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/actions/runs/37395427989) and [37395470911](https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/actions/runs/37395470911)) each paged **🚨 CRITICAL: Review-blocked judge action: security_hold**. Neither PR was broken:

- On both, autofix hit its cap and the review-blocked judge chose **merge**.
- The single-issue security merge gate from #6377 then held that merge, because it had just dispatched a retry audit of the head (`mode=gate … outcome=dispatched cycle=6 … reason=exhausted_retry`).
- That audit re-runs the review and brings the judge back with no human needed. The two audits are runs 37396531584 and 37396777368.

The "Telegram review-blocked judge decision" step in `review_autofix.yml` had no `security_hold` case. So this normal wait fell through to the generic `*)` branch and was sent at CRITICAL.

The judge couldn't simply be made quiet for every `security_hold`. Some holds don't clear by themselves: a failed dispatch, retry attempts used up without a completed audit, or a gate that failed. Those still need a page. This PR passes the gate's hold reason through to the alert step.

## Changes

- **`scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh`**: every `hold=true` now also writes `hold_reason=<reason>`. The reasons are `audit_dispatched`, `audit_pending`, `awaiting_followups`, `markers_unverifiable`, `extensions_unverifiable`, `label_write_failed`, `cycles_exhausted`, `exhausted_without_completed_audit` and `d

2026-10-07T03:52:13.3462583Z   pr_body: ## Summary

### 1. CLAUDE.md §29: OpenRouter Access
When a task needs OpenRouter data, interactive sessions now fetch it themselves with the `OR_MGMT_KEY` management key in the session environment. The section follows the same pattern as §22–§24:
- **Reads are self-serve:** `/api/v1/activity`, `/api/v1/keys` and `/api/v1/credits`.
- **Ask first** before creating, deleting or limiting a key, or making any billing change.
- **Token hygiene** rules apply.
- **Interactive sessions only.**

It also records the API limits, verified live on 2026-10-06:
- 30-day window, with HTTP 400 for older dates
- account-wide data split by model only
- `usage_monthly` is the calendar month

When a task needs OpenRouter data, interactive sessions now fetch it themselves with the `OR_MGMT_KEY` management key in the session environment. The section follows the same pattern as §22–§24:
- **Reads are self-serve:** `/api/v1/activity`, `/api/v1/keys` and `/api/v1/credits`.

- **Token hygiene** rules apply.
- **Interactive sessions only.**

- 30-day window, with HTTP 400 for older dates
- account-wide data split by model only
- `usage_monthly` is the calendar month
